The kill switch

a ceiling that refuses, not one that apologises

The client estimates each call before making it and raises if it would take the run past $25.00. The check happens before the request is sent, and the test asserts on call count rather than on the ledger total — a ledger inspected after the fact is not a ceiling. The same mechanism caps deep-tier calls at exactly one per run.
